name: application-file-tree
title: File Tree
description: Collapsible nested directory/file explorer with indent guides and icons; folders expand independently and files render as real links with an active-file state.
useWhen: Building a code editor, docs site, or file-management sidebar that needs a nested folder/file hierarchy.
Users need to expand and collapse folders independently while an active file stays highlighted.
You want indent guides so deep nesting stays readable at a glance.
avoidWhen: The navigation is a flat, non-hierarchical list of links — use Vertical Menu or Side Menu instead.
You need drag-and-drop reordering or multi-select — this is a read/navigate-only tree, not a file manager.
responsiveBehavior: The tree scrolls vertically within its container at any width; indentation is fixed so very deep trees may need a wider sidebar rather than shrinking indent size.
accessibility: The root list carries role="tree" with an aria-label, each item role="treeitem", and nested folders role="group" — matching the WAI-ARIA tree view pattern.
Folder rows are real <button> elements exposing aria-expanded so assistive technology announces open/closed state.
The active file link carries aria-current="page".
File and folder icons are aria-hidden since the adjacent name text conveys the same information.

variants.title: File Tree
variants.description: A src folder open with a components subfolder (Button.tsx active, Card.tsx), a collapsed hooks folder, and index.ts, plus a sibling package.json.
accessibility: Each folder toggles independently; collapsing a parent does not lose the expanded/collapsed state of siblings.

variants.title: File Tree (Dark)
variants.description: The same nested file tree adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Indent guide lines and the active-file highlight remain visible at dark-surface contrast.
